hub_token.help: SDK token can be found in https://modelscope.cn/my/myaccesstoken

teacher_model_server.help: URL of the teacher model server (e.g., http://localhost:8000). When set, teacher logprobs are fetched via API instead of loading a local model. Supports multi-teacher via JSON.

teacher_tag_key.help: Column name for multi-teacher routing. Default "dataset".
